title: coreocarpus insularis
intro: Coreocarpus insularis, commonly known as Island Coreopsis, is a plant species native to the Hawaiian Islands. It is used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties, and research has identified various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, which may include wound healing, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer activities. Further studies are needed to fully understand the plant's potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
